title: M2 Tailnet guarded recovery checkpoint

status.implementation: V8 guarded recovery and the exact V11 uncertain-run resolver were installed on the private Linux service host.
status.scope: One strict, gated automatic recovery attempt per genuine offline event was approved. This checkpoint did not trigger or validate that positive path.

local_validation.static_review: High-level review found no P1/P2 issue; this is not a security audit.

host_validation.manual_stop_behavior: The service stopped and drained; watchdog remained active; Shields Up was true; no offline episode or recovery attempt was recorded.
host_validation.final_state: Service and watchdog active; recovery unit inactive; Tailnet Running/Online; Shields Up false while serving; private HTTPS returned 200; database integrity check passed; zero queued, running, or uncertain runs; Kata namespace empty.

preserved_point_in_time_counts.grant_delta: Validation actions created no grant; an independent before/after grant baseline was not established.

limits: No genuine V8 Self.Online=false event or watchdog exit 42 was induced, so no positive automatic recovery occurred.
Safe fault isolation could not be guaranteed; the guarded positive path remains unverified and pilot_ready remains false.

A failed paired status/preference sample during the 60-second stability window immediately rejects that event; the implementation does not reset and restart the window as described in the earlier proposal text.
Live manual-start interleaving and requester provenance were not tested in a host race; these controls cannot be claimed as verified.
Resolver checks exercised denial cases only; no production uncertain run was resolved.
The earlier V7 failure at 2026-09-29T22:24:32Z after category=offline remains unexplained.
A parent check confirmed unit states and Tailnet Running/Online with Shields Up false. A separate file-mode check timed out, so file ownership and mode are not independently claimed here.
Point-in-time health, service start/stop checks, hashes, and local test results do not prove continuous health, safe positive recovery, an uptime bound, or broad security assurance.
